paper.title_en: Entropy and charge transport limit Mpemba preparation in holography
paper.abstract_en: We study Mpemba relaxation and its preparation cost in a holographic superconductor with full backreaction. At matched final energy and charge, boundary drives can reverse the ordering of the remaining horizon entropy after source removal. In separate numerical comparisons, some protocols reach a given tolerance earlier even when driving and waiting times are included. To examine the limits of preparation, we consider critical states that already carry a slow scalar field and exterior charge. Along the critical slow branch at fixed energy and charge, horizon displacement cancels the quadratic area response, leaving an entropy reserve of $O(\varepsilon^4)$ for an initial scalar amplitude $\varepsilon$. The same coefficient connects this reserve to the entropy advantage of the nearby superconducting equilibrium and the entropy weight of the slow tail on the normal side. This limited reserve constrains how quickly the existing field can be removed. For releases that suppress the leading horizon field and exterior charge, the preparation time grows at least as $\varepsilon^{-2}$ under horizon regularity and uniform radial control. Charge transport constrains the same covariant scalar flux that produces horizon entropy, raising the minimum flux cost and strengthening the time bound.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在带完全反作用的全息超导体中研究 Mpemba 弛豫及其制备成本，主题属于全息凝聚态物理；涉及临界慢支上的熵储备、制备时间下界以及电荷输运对协变标量通量的约束，理论层次与方法细节较丰富，值得点进阅读。零引用且论文年龄仅3天，按规则不扣分。
decision.title_zh: 熵与电荷输运限制全息中的 Mpemba 制备
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究带完全反作用的 holographic 超导体中的 Mpemba 弛豫及其制备成本。在匹配的末态能量与电荷下，边界驱动可以在移除源之后反转剩余视界熵的排序。在分开的数值比较中，即使把驱动时间和等待时间计入，某些方案仍更早达到给定容差。为考察制备的极限，我们考虑已携带慢标量场和外部电荷的临界态。在固定能量与电荷的临界慢支上，视界位移抵消了二次面积响应，对于初始标量振幅 $\varepsilon$，留下 $O(\varepsilon^4)$ 的熵储备。同一系数将这一储备与附近超导平衡态的熵优势以及正常侧慢尾的熵权重联系起来。这一有限的储备约束了现有场能被多快移除。对于抑制主导视界场和外部电荷的释放，在视界正则性和一致径向控制下，制备时间至少按 $\varepsilon^{-2}$ 增长。电荷输运约束同一产生视界熵的协变标量通量，提高了最小通量成本并强化了时间下界。
